Package ro.ubb.map.retea.repository.db

Class UtilizatorDbRepository

java.lang.Object
ro.ubb.map.retea.repository.db.UtilizatorDbRepository
All Implemented Interfaces:
Repository<Long,Utilizator>
public class UtilizatorDbRepository extends Object
PostgreSQL repository for users (table users). All the statements are PreparedStatements with ? parameters, so a name such as '); DROP TABLE users; -- is stored as plain text. The id is generated by the database. The optional username of a user is not stored (the table has no such column) and the friends list is built by the service.

    • save

      public Optional<Utilizator> save(Utilizator entity)
      Saves a user. The id is generated by the database: an id already set on the entity is ignored and overwritten with the generated one.
      Parameters:
      entity - the user to save; cannot be null
      Returns:
      always an empty Optional (the user is saved; its id is set on entity)
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the entity is null
      ValidationException - if the user is not valid
      RepositoryException - if the database cannot be accessed

    • delete

      public Optional<Utilizator> delete(Long id)
      Deletes the entity with the given id. The friendships of the user are removed by the service; the database cascade is only a safety net.
      Parameters:
      id - the id of the entity; cannot be null
      Returns:
      the deleted entity, or an empty Optional if it does not exist
      Throws:
      RepositoryException - if the database cannot be accessed

    • update

      public Optional<Utilizator> update(Utilizator entity)
      Updates an existing entity (with the same id), after validating it. A user without id cannot exist in the database, so it is reported as missing.
      Parameters:
      entity - the new version of the entity; cannot be null
      Returns:
      an empty Optional if the entity was updated, otherwise the given entity (the id does not exist)
      Throws:
      RepositoryException - if the database cannot be accessed
